title: Punycode Converter
description: Converts internationalized domain names and email addresses to and from Punycode (RFC 3492/3490 separators). operation: toASCII (default, adds xn-- to non-ASCII labels), toUnicode (decodes xn-- labels), encode or decode (raw label, no xn--). Returns {valid, operation, input, output}; malformed Punycode returns valid:false with error (invalid-input, not-basic, overflow) and message. No Nameprep/UTS46 mapping is applied, matching punycode.js.
